children: According to Sina Finance, Peter Clark, senior vice president of ExxonMobil International Ltd.'s LNG business, said ExxonMobil expects its global LNG sales portfolio to reach about 50 million tons a year by 2030, up from a previous forecast of 40 million tons. Clark said in an interview on Monday at the International Gas Technology Conference in Bangkok that global LNG demand is expected to rise from about 400 million tons currently to 500 million tons in 2030, and that LNG demand is expected to reach 1 billion tons by 2050.

title: ExxonMobil Plans to Lift LNG Sales to 50 Million Tons a Year by 2030
